question: In Figure 2.7, compare medium-skill and low-skill net employment changes during 2015–2020. Give approximate magnitudes, directions, units, and the two legend colors.
answer:
During 2015–2020 in Figure 2.7, medium-skill net employment changed by an increase of approximately 2,900 thousand (orange legend color). [p078-figure-2.7]

During 2015–2020 in Figure 2.7, low-skill net employment changed by a decrease of approximately 3,100 thousand (grey legend color). [p078-figure-2.7]
